title: PCR Prep with 1.5 mL Tubes Part 2 - Adding Sample
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure robot parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters in the OT‑2 protocol: Number of Samples (total tubes to process; e.g., 32 will trigger one tube‑rack replacement after 15 samples and then only the first two tubes are used after replacement), Aspirate Saliva Delay Time in seconds (delay after aspirating saliva or saliva/buffer to ensure complete aspiration), P300 Multi‑Channel Mount (choose left or right), and P20 Single‑Channel Mount (choose left or right).

steps.title: Add saliva and mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate saliva (or saliva/buffer) into each buffer plate well, apply the configured delay, then mix the solution six times. When the robot has processed the specified Number of Samples, it will pause and prompt the user to replace the tube rack; continue until all samples are transferred.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate saliva with the set delay time
When prompted, replace the tube rack and resume until all samples are processed

steps.title: Add diluted saliva and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the diluted saliva from the buffer plates to the mastermix plate and mix the contents.
